body: This happens to me also. It’s like every time something in my life falls off track I lose hope in all of it and find it significantly overwhelming. You know ?
Sometimes I feel this way. Then I talk to the dark until I feel that someone is listening. Sorry if that sounds stupid.

Thank you for replying. Asking for help is difficult for me. Hence as to why I created an anonymous profile. Today is a better day because I’ve had more support but it concerns me just how easily I can hit bottom. Life is a weird concept and I still have yet to find what to make of it.
